title: Intent capture — an optional one-line why at save time
roadmap_anchor: Q2 > Retrieval, before intelligence > Intent capture
acceptance: An optional single-line why field is offered at save time in both the app and the share extension
Skipping it costs nothing and never blocks a save
The field is searchable and shown in search results
Existing posts are unaffected and the field stays empty for them
notes: The roadmap's most differentiated cheap feature and the highest-signal text to embed in Q3. Data-model plus extension change.
